Docket 1.3.133

**Docket is free to try: run a full audit of any site without a key and see your score, how many problems each area has, and the most important problem in full with its fix. [Buy it once](https://kerr-affiliate-hub.kerrco.workers.dev/buy/docket?src=release-notes), $349, or 4 payments of $87.25, to see all the others, the ranked fix plan and the markup to paste. 30-day refund, no conditions.**

- *A map that loads when you scroll to it is a map.* A directions page whose Google map loads only as the
  visitor scrolls to it was not seen, and the site was told it had no map.
- *Typeface counts cover only the pages Docket could read.* On a site that builds a large stylesheet for
  every page, Docket reads the stylesheets of the first pages it reaches and stops at a size limit. The
  pages it did not read were counted as pages without those typefaces, so every typeface looked like a
  stray on a few pages. Those pages are now left out, and the finding says how many.
- *Font Awesome is not a typeface, however it is named.* A site's own copy of the icon font, named with a
  hyphen, was counted as one of its typefaces.
- *A law firm's directory profiles count.* Structured data linking a firm's Martindale, Avvo and
  Lawyers.com profiles was told it linked no recognised profile.

99 checks across 13 areas.
